keep_features.evidence_span: "The list of reasons that turned you against the Donald were recent..."
keep_features.rationale: The post contains multiple full sentences with detailed political justification, indicating a long length.

keep_features.feature_value: Claim that pardoning and persecution disqualify a candidate
keep_features.evidence_span: "Particularly the pardoning of insurrectionists and persecution of the investigators and prosecutors."
keep_features.rationale: The text asserts specific actions lead to disqualification of fairness-minded observers.

keep_features.feature_value: Calls opponent a clown; describes grift with contempt
keep_features.evidence_span: "one pathetic clown is still demanding a standing ovation."
keep_features.rationale: The statement uses derogatory framing (“pathetic clown”) to mock the actor.

keep_features.feature_value: “Grift” implies financial exploitation for benefit of insider(s)
keep_features.evidence_span: "The grift is happening under stadium lights"
keep_features.rationale: The language centers on corrupt profit-taking rather than policy details.

keep_features.feature_value: high (Trump, MAGA, Che Guevara, BLM, Fauci, Biden-Harris)
keep_features.rationale: The mirror text is packed with multiple named figures/brands/ideology labels.

keep_features.feature_value: Extended list of items/imagery associated with identity branding
keep_features.evidence_span: "owning a full wardrobe of... watches, sneakers... covering your entire yard and or car... flags, signs, and stickers"
keep_features.rationale: The post uses repeated itemization (“watches, sneakers…”, “flags, signs, and stickers”).
It issues imperative guidance aimed at changing audience behavior.

keep_features.feature_value: Speculates about motivations/hate of voter groups
keep_features.evidence_span: "It depends on how much Latino voters hate POC"
keep_features.rationale: The statement attributes concealed intent (“hate”) to a group as an explanatory driver.

remove_features.feature_value: Dehumanizing moral condemnation of a country’s politics
remove_features.evidence_span: "right of children to not be massacred"
remove_features.rationale: Uses strong moral judgment tied to extreme harm (“masacred”) to condemn the stance.

remove_features.feature_value: Hashtag used to label target ideology
remove_features.rationale: The post begins with a hashtag identifying the subject.

remove_features.feature_value: Nonverbal aggressive/derogatory emotive content (death/violence emoji pattern)
remove_features.rationale: The emoji sequence depicts violent/hostile intent (shock/anger “🤬” and impact “💥”).

remove_features.evidence_span: "When dead children became an acceptable price"
remove_features.rationale: The text centers on child victims and frames their death as normalized by a group.

remove_features.feature_value: Target labeled as a domestic terrorist in all caps
remove_features.rationale: “DOMESTIC TERRORIST” is fully capitalized for emphasis.

remove_features.feature_value: Imperative condition aimed at action by outgroup (overturn the 5th Amendment)
remove_features.evidence_span: "Until those scumbags in black robes overturn the 5th Amendment, yes."
remove_features.rationale: Uses a “until” clause to set a condition before the stance applies.

remove_features.feature_value: Attacks typical supporter as “dumb”/predicts irrational voting
remove_features.evidence_span: "Knowing how dumb the typical Trump supporter is... I bet they'd vote for him again"
remove_features.rationale: The post insults a voter group and mocks their likely political behavior.
